ctx.x: So then that broke up the place again, see. He was quite a guy. But they couldn't get along. And Sidney, bless his soul, and my teacher, Lorenzo Tio, they came to New York. Now, Lorenzo, he had just finished having a stroke, so he and Bechet got together and they were going to open up a speakeasy.

So they bought a lot of gin, bathtub gin they used to call it in those days, and the place -- they were going to paint the little one-horse room they had there for a bar. So that day they started painting and then they were looking, everybody couldn't find Bechet nor Tio. They didn't know where they were. They were looking for them. And both of those characters was drunk behind the bar.
